items.title: Repligen’s deal for BioLife Solutions indicates shift to manufacturing integration
items.summary: Repligen’s $1.5bn purchase of BioLife Solutions adds CryoStor biopreservation to its bioprocessing portfolio, underscoring pharma’s shift toward integrated cell and gene therapy supply chains.

items.title: United global response to US childhood vaccine overhaul
items.summary: Recommended changes to the US immunisation schedule by President Trump have been met with widespread retaliation.

items.title: Akeso secures China NMPA authorisation for ivonescimab combo
items.summary: Summit Therapeutics’ partner Akeso has secured China’s NMPA authorisation for the use of ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy as a first-line treatment for advanced squamous NSCLC patients.

items.title: Eli Lilly cracks down on illicit weight loss drug trade with US lawsuits
items.summary: Eli Lilly is suing several US companies that are allegedly selling illegal versions of its weight loss candidate, retatrutide.

items.title: Remepy secures $36m funding for hybrid drug pipeline expansion
items.summary: Remepy has secured $36m in Series A funds to accelerate its pharmaceutical co-development partnerships and expand its hybrid drug pipeline.
